dedupe_keys.name: hydropowerlib run of river generation model

description: hydropowerlib is a Python package for estimating the electricity output of run-of-river hydropower plants. It takes streamflow series and turbine characteristics, with default parameter sets for common turbine types, and calculates feed-in time series. Users may replace those defaults with plant-specific parameters. Geographic coverage and time period follow the input river and flow record. GPL-3.0 source, example data links and Read the Docs documentation are public. The repository last published code in 2019, so compatibility with recent Python and dependency versions needs checking. A limitation is that a simple flow-to-output calculation does not model reservoir operations, environmental flow rules or turbine downtime. hydropowerlib can supply generation profiles for power-system planning where run-of-river sites are relevant. The related catalogue PyPSA model can use electricity profiles but is not part of this package. No example flow series or Python package was downloaded.
